teacher_info.introduction: I have a vast and varied history. I studied business and accounting in college. From the topics, to grammar focus, nothing is off limits. I add value and give suggestions, but prefer to follow your lead as you know you the best! I may know English better, but you are the expert on you. I like to use your real life situations as often as possible for class material, but there are also endless learning possibilities online. I work with all levels of students, but do prefer to work with adults (no young children, but mature teens are great). teacher_info.about_teacher: I absolutely LOVE teaching and connecting with students.  I am very relaxed and easy to connect with so hopefully you are never too nervous in my class.  Sharing information with you and helping you become the best version of yourself (and your English) are two of my top strengths and passions.  I am patient and understand how it feels to be a language learning student no matter what level you are at.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are filled with conversations, fun and feedback.  I believe that the more relaxed you are, the better you can learn.  If you're too nervous/stressed, the brain shuts down a bit and doesn't work optimally.  Being perfect isn't necessary, but the ability to understand and make yourself understood.  Once you can do that, you can start working on making everything better (on every level).  I encourage my students to be as involved in their learning process as possible.  The more you give, the more you get.  This is true for everything in life.  I don't give homework but there are many ways that you can continue to practice between classes and we can find something that suits you best.

The ripple effect from this new understanding has no limits.  People often see improvements in their job/business/career, relationship, self acceptance/self love, etc.

Welcome to English class! This is the general class for students to take. Here, we will learn all about American Grammar, American Pronunciation, and American Vocabulary. Have a real conversation with a native, and I will check what you know, and what you need to learn! And we can talk about anything!

This class is not very formal, but it is effective. I won’t give you useless activities or waste your time. Only what you need. You’re going to speak, and speak a lot!

This class is almost 100% focused on speaking, with some reading for material. I do not focus on writing at all. All materials are free, this is a real course.

As we continue, you’ll be able to see your improvement. I’ll give you a lot of time to talk, and I’ll be listening for errors. The most important job I have is to correct your errors, and show you why they’re wrong. I’m dedicated to making sure your English is the same as mine, as native as possible.

In this class I use grammar books, pictures, articles, lists, and many more materials to help you understand the best way possible.

Let’s learn together! I’m looking forward to building our English relationship.

Grammar Test 4 - High Int – Adv: it is also recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1, 2, and 3 before trying Test 4. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 4 indicates that students should use our intermediate – high-intermediate materials. Bisher habe ich hauptsächlich an einer Universität unterrichtet. Ich verfüge aber auch über langjährige Erfahrung im Online-Unterrichten. Meine Studenten besitzen unterschiedliche sprachliche Vorkenntnisse, von Beginnern bis zu Studenten, die die englische Sprache bereits nahezu perfekt beherrschen.

Wenn dir mein Profil zusagt, würde ich mich freuen, wenn du mich kontaktieren würdest und ich dir helfen kann deine Sprachkompetenz weiter zu verbessern!

pro_course_detail.title: Informal Tutoring

pro_course_detail.title: Professional Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency!
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to improve your conversational English in a low stress environment? 
Want to improve your fluency and speak English with more confidence?

Do you feel like you understand grammar better than you can speak? These lessons are designed for you! 

During our time together we will have a relaxed conversation about topics important to you. These lessons focus on pronunciation, fluency, learning to speak with confidence, being able to articulate what you want to say, and help improve your listening skills as we speak American English together. 

We can focus on either social conversation, or more professional style conversation, depending on your needs. These lessons do not have homework and the goal of these lessons is to remain relaxed.

I will typically not make many corrections during our time together in order to not break the conversational fluency practice. (I will make corrections during the lesson upon request of the student, and also if there is a repeating error which is hindering our time).

These lessons are for all levels of English and a trial lesson is not needed.

* The primary difference between professional and social English is whether colloquial speech is used. Colloquial speech is basically “common slang” which is very common in movies, music, and among friends, but not usually appropriate in a professional setting.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading – University Papers and Professional Documents
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have a university or professional paper in need of proofreading?

While I am not able to write or re-write papers for you, I will correct spelling, grammar, and offer suggestions when a sentence is not worded naturally. I will always grade for spelling and grammar, while word choice will be graded based on the individual's English level. (English levels A1-native)

You will need to send me the paper in advance of the lesson as an attachment so that I am able to proofread your document. Please note that all papers require that I am given the paper at least 5 work days in advance of the lesson. However, the true length of time needed will only be given after you are able to provide me with the paper. This is because the amount of time I need for proofreading depends on the topic as well as your personal English level and ability.

You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF). A short explanation of the goal of the paper is also needed. 

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format. I will then return the corrected paper back to you by the time of the scheduled lesson.

Please note that an hour lesson is up to 1000 words. (This is a little over a 4 page paper double spaced in 12 point Times New Roman font). 

If the paper is longer, you are able to book additional hours to cover the correct word count. (For example, up to 1000 words requires an hour lesson, up to 2000 words requires two hours to be booked,  up to 3000 words requires 3 hours to be booked, etc.)

Please keep in mind that an hour lesson is for the time spent making corrections. If you would like to additionally discuss the corrections over Skype, please consult my “Discussion of University and Professional Papers” class. I appreciate your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Discussion of University and Professional Papers
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to discuss proofreading corrections over Skype video or chat?
Would you like to discuss grammatical corrections you received from a professor at your school?
Would you like to discuss another document to receive a native perspective?
This course is for you!

This course has two main focuses. The first focus is discussing corrections which either I or another professor had given you. The second focus is discussing questions you have concerning your own edits.

Please be sure to send me the document prior to the lesson as either an email or Skype attachment. You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF).

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format.

Please note that this lesson is intended to discuss corrections over Skype in either chat or video. If you would like me to professionally proofread your paper, please consult my other “Proofreading Papers” class. I appreciate your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Perfect Pronunciation Drilling!
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for advanced speakers of English. If you are able to speak fluently, but your accent is simply not improving, this class is designed for you.

This is an intensive class which helps you improve your accent and your ability to pronounce words naturally and correctly. 

Areas we will address include:
- articulation (the actual pronunciation of words)
- intonation (the rise and fall of your voice)
- stress (the emphasis of words)

During this class you will need to read a text. I will provide the text for us to review, but if you have your own text which you would like to read, please keep in mind that your text will need to be at least two pages long and I will need a copy of your text at least 24 hours in advance.

Please also keep in mind that this class is not designed to improve your conversation skills or fluency. This class strictly focuses on your pronunciation in order to reduce your accent. 

If you are interested in improving your speaking ability so that you are able to speak with more confidence and fluency, you are looking for my “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class. 

My “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class also addresses your accent and pronunciation, but unlike this class, it is additionally designed to improve your speaking ability overall, with a focus on improving your confidence and fluency.
